_note: v2 hooks for le Passage des Paquets (ST_paquets, S02_home): a covered stone arcade with a red tile roof and stacked packages on a rainy day, the packages street (ST_control seg015-018). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_etaler_verb.why: TALL → étaler = to spread out (étaler une carte, étaler du beurre). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-ta-LAY -> ay-tah-LAY).

fr_entasser_verb.why: IN TASSEL → s'entasser = to crowd together, to pile up; entasser = to pile up (entasser des cartons). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (on-ta-SAY) -> (ahn-tah-SAY) to match the card.
